newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Vietnam approves Anzoil gas drilling.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Vietnam approves Anzoil gas drilling.

text.p: Anzoil NL said on Monday its 80 percent-owned subsidiary, Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd, has won approval from Vietnam's state energy concern, PetroVietnam, to drill the first appraisal well on the Song Tra Ly D14 gas discovery in the onshore Hanoi basin.
The D14-STL-2 will be directionally drilled from the D14-STL-1x surface location to a bottom hole location 1.5km east of the D14-STL-1x discovery, Anzoil said.

The prognosed measured depth of D14-STL-2 will be 3851 metres. Parker Drilling Rig 200 will be moved back to the D14 appraisal upon completion of work at the currently drilling Song Thai Binh B1-STB-1x test.
The D14-STL-2 appraisal well is the first of a multiwell appraisal program planned by Anzoil to confirm proven reserves at the significant D14 gas find.
Independent petroleum engineering consultant OPES International Pty Ltd calculates gas in place at 1139 BCF at D14.
At 2.16 p.m. (0412 GMT), Anzoil shares were trading one cent lower at A$0.17. Frotnier Petroleum, which holds a 20 percent interest in (Anzoil Asia), was unchanged at A$0.22.
